text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

RICE SALE - Sri Lanka's state buying arm, the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment, has bought 12,500 tonnes of white rice from Pakistan at $226.85 per tonne and freight free out of Colombo, government officials said. The rice, from Qaiser Noman and Co Ltd, is for shipment before December 15.

RICE SALE - The Food Agency of Japan said on Friday that it bought 10,000 tonnes of rice in an import tender. It said it bought 7,159 tonnes from the United States, 2,199 from China, 319 from Uruguay, 272 from Australia, and 51 from Thailand. Under the 1993 Uruguay Round world trade agreement, Japan agreed to gradually open its rice market and committed itself to importing 511,000 tonnes of rice during this fiscal year, which ends in March 1997. It has bought 155,300 tonnes so far this fiscal year, mainly from Thailand, Australia and the United States.

RICE TENDER - Costa Rica will be seeking 46,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain paddy rice on November 13 , U.S. exporters said. The deal includes two shipments of 23,000 tonnes each. One lot was slated for February 24-March 4 arrival and another lot was set for April 1-8.
WHEAT TENDER - Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Thursday he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of standard soft white Australian wheat for delivery between December 11 and 31.
- He was also extending the deadline for seeking 100,000 tonnes of Argentinian wheat to November 15 from Thursday November 14. The wheat would be for loading from Dec 12-31.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was tendering Nov 13 for up to 80,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, for Bangladesh. Shipment was for Dec 1-25, 1996.
SOYOIL TENDER - The CCC is to tender Nov 6 for 13,000 tonnes of crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The oil was slated for Dec 14-30 delivery.

VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt seeks up to 35,000 T edible oils for first half January; 10,000 to 15,000 T crude sunflower oil or semi-refined cottonseed oil or U.S. cottonseed oil grade 162, 5,000 to 10,000 T degummed soyoil, any origin and 10,000 tonnes of palm oil of Malaysian or Indonesian origin.

COTTONSEED MEAL TENDER - South Korean feed mill companies have invited tenders for 10,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal by 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday for January and February arrival,traders said. LENTIL TENDER - CCC said it was seeking to buy 900 tonnes of lentils for export to Iraq. Offers should be submitted by November 18 for reply the following day. Shipment was slated for December 6-20. Offers will be accepted to Jacintoport, Texas only.

MARKET TALK - Turkish wheat importers, whose cargoes of U.S. milling wheat have been held up at ports by the government for two weeks on grounds they might contain ergot fungus, said on Friday they were allowed to bring the cargoes into the country following the approval of health clearances.
